title: 不对称星形负载：有中线时的中线电流
statement: 对称三相电源（正序，U̇_A = 220∠0° V）以三相四线制向照明负载供电，中线阻抗为零。三相负载都是纯电阻（白炽灯组）：R_A = 11 Ω，R_B = R_C = 22 Ω。电流表 A_N 测量从 N' 流向 N 的中线电流 İ_N。
求 A、B 两相的电流有效值、中线电流表读数和 İ_N 的初相。

questions.ask: A 相电流有效值 I_A = ?
questions.explain: 有理想中线，U̇_N'N = 0，各相负载仍承受电源相电压：I_A = 220/11 = 20 A。

questions.ask: B 相电流有效值 I_B = ?
中线电流表 A_N 的读数 = ?

hints: 中线阻抗为零时，N' 与 N 等电位，三相各自独立：每相负载电压就是电源相电压。
分别算出三个相电流相量（纯电阻，电流与各自的相电压同相）。
中线电流是三个相电流的相量和——不对称时它不再为零。
solution: **1. 各相独立。** 中线把 N' 钳在 N 的电位上，U̇_A'N' = U̇_A，等等。
**结论：** 负载不对称时中线中有电流，但正是这根中线保证了每相负载电压都等于 220 V。所以照明系统必须用三相四线制，中线上不允许装熔断器或开关（见下一题：中线断开会怎样）。

en.title: Unbalanced wye load: neutral current with a neutral wire
statement: A balanced three-phase source (positive sequence, U̇_A = 220∠0° V) supplies a lighting load over a four-wire system whose neutral has zero impedance. All three load phases are pure resistances (banks of incandescent lamps): R_A = 11 Ω, R_B = R_C = 22 Ω. Ammeter A_N measures the neutral current İ_N flowing from N' to N.
Find the rms currents of phases A and B, the reading of the neutral ammeter and the phase of İ_N.

questions.ask: rms current of phase A, I_A = ?
questions.explain: With an ideal neutral, U̇_N'N = 0 and each load phase still sees the source phase voltage: I_A = 220/11 = 20 A.

questions.ask: rms current of phase B, I_B = ?
Reading of the neutral ammeter A_N = ?

hints: With a zero-impedance neutral, N' and N are at the same potential and the phases are independent: each load phase sees its source phase voltage.
Find the three phase-current phasors (pure resistances, so each current is in phase with its own phase voltage).
The neutral current is the phasor sum of the three phase currents — for an unbalanced load it is no longer zero.
solution: **1. Independent phases.** The neutral clamps N' to the potential of N, so U̇_A'N' = U̇_A, and so on.
**3. Neutral current (KCL).** İ_N = İ_A + İ_B + İ_C = 20 + (−5 − j8.66) + (−5 + j8.66) = **10∠0° A**, so the ammeter reads **10 A**.

**Conclusion:** with an unbalanced load the neutral carries current, but it is exactly this wire that keeps every load phase at 220 V. That is why lighting is supplied by a four-wire system and no fuse or switch is allowed in the neutral (see the next problem: what happens when the neutral is broken).
